entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. Could I get your full name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Thank you, Ms. Evans. Pulling that up now... I see your recent purchase for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on January 16th. That was 12 days ago. To get started, is it a technical fault with the device, or is this more of a preference issue?
It works fine. I just changed my mind.
I understand. Many of our members find it takes a week or so to really appreciate all the features. Have you had a chance to explore the advanced sleep cycle analysis or the trail mapping functions?
Look, I don't use it. It was an impulse buy, and I want my money back.
Okay, I appreciate the clarity. One moment while I review the return eligibility for this item.
Alright, thank you for your patience. So, I'm checking the policy... hmm. Actually, wait. Let me just pull up our main knowledge base. I want to be absolutely certain for you.

Ah, yes. Here it is. My apologies, I was looking at an old bulletin. Our official VeloFit policy clearly states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 12, you are well within the window.
So you can process the return, then?

Yes, absolutely. I'm generating a prepaid return label for you right now. It will be in your inbox in the next few minutes. I also see you're a VIP member with us, Ms. Evans. As a thank you for your loyalty and for your patience, I've added a $25 VeloFit credit to your account.
The email has just been sent. Once our warehouse receives the VeloBand, the full refund will be issued to your original payment method. Was there anything else I could help with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
